children.text: Note: This guide will go over how to complete the Combat achievements for Zuk, and assumes you are already familiar with the basic mechanics of the encounter which can be found here
Ful of Energy But Nowhere To Go
⬥ Defeat TzKal-Zuk in hard mode in a single run without moving after attacking the 'Conduit of Ful' in wave 18.
‎ ‎ ‎ ‎• You are allowed to move after the conduit has spawned, just not after you have started attacking it
Make sure to be at full health, max
